selected_items.summary: The durable product vision defines an authorized, defensive, explainable Demo-to-report workflow, required acquisition/parser/analysis/report capabilities, conservative uncertainty handling, non-goals, and executable acceptance gates without prescribing the retired source structure.

The machine contract freezes nine capability groups, prohibited claims/actions, and nine acceptance checks including real parser proof, unknown-information preservation, accuracy NOT_EVALUATED, no automatic ban, and delivery-route boundaries.

A previous fresh Provider run passed Foundation and Backend but expanded into nineteen Backend and nineteen Test leaves, then stopped on nine HTTP 504 and five provider-key usage-limit fallbacks before any test leaf completed or candidate materialized.
The old working project was removed to the Windows recycle bin after its vision was sealed; historical artifacts and formal candidates remain, and the rebuild output identity is fresh and absent.
